other_mijikenda: Swahili: shares the name mkuyu (Pakia App. VI)

teaser.en: A fig with leaves as big as dinner plates, often starting life high in another tree.
teaser.sw: Mkuyu wenye majani makubwa kama sahani za chakula, ambao mara nyingi huanza maisha yake juu ya mti mwingine.

summary.en: *Chiuzi* is the giant-leaved fig, a large tree with huge leathery leaves and clusters of small yellowish figs. Digo also call it *mkuyu*, a name they share with the Cape fig.
summary.sw: *Chiuzi* ni mkuyu wenye majani makubwa (giant-leaved fig), mti mkubwa wenye majani makubwa mno yaliyo magumu kama ngozi, na vishada vya tini ndogo za rangi ya manjano hafifu. Wadigo pia huuita *mkuyu*, jina wanalolitumia pia kwa *Ficus sur* (Cape fig).

about.en: *Ficus lutea* is a large, spreading fig tree with milky latex and very large, thick, leathery leaves, up to about 30 cm long. It often begins life as an epiphyte or strangler in the crown of another tree, sending roots down to the ground. The small figs are yellowish to orange-brown and grow in dense clusters along the twigs behind the leaves, where birds, bats and monkeys feed on them. Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Ficus lutea* ni mkuyu mkubwa unaotanda, wenye utomvu mweupe kama maziwa na majani makubwa sana, manene na magumu kama ngozi, yenye urefu wa hadi takriban sentimita 30. Mara nyingi huanza maisha kama mmea-tegemezi au mnyongaji katika taji la mti mwingine, na kushusha mizizi hadi ardhini. Tini zake ndogo ni za manjano hadi hudhurungi-machungwa, na huota kwa vishada vizito kando ya vitawi nyuma ya majani, ambapo ndege, popo na tumbili huja kuzila. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.

where.en: It grows in forest, riverine woodland and coastal bush across tropical Africa, from West Africa to Kenya and south to South Africa.
where.sw: Hukua msituni, katika misitu ya kando ya mito na vichakani pwani katika Afrika yote ya kitropiki, kuanzia Afrika Magharibi hadi Kenya na kusini hadi Afrika Kusini.

uses.en: Pakia records that Digo use the latex of fig trees (*Ficus*) to fix feathers onto arrow shafts; he doesn't name this species.
uses.sw: Pakia anaripoti kwamba Wadigo hutumia utomvu wa mikuyu (*Ficus*) kubandika manyoya kwenye vijiti vya mishale; hata hivyo hataji spishi hii kwa jina.

names.en: Pakia records two names: *chiuzi*, and *mkuyu*, which he also gives for the Cape fig (*Ficus sur*). *Mkuyu* is shared with Swahili, where it is a general name for wild figs. The existing reference also has a fig called *uuzi kaha*, *Ficus stuhlmannii*, so *chiuzi* may be a small form of *uuzi*, but Pakia doesn't explain it.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina mawili: *chiuzi*, na *mkuyu*, ambalo pia analitoa kwa *Ficus sur* (*Cape fig*). *Mkuyu* ni jina la pamoja na Kiswahili, ambapo ni jina la jumla la mikuyu ya porini. Marejeo yaliyopo pia yana mkuyu unaoitwa *uuzi kaha*, *Ficus stuhlmannii*, kwa hivyo huenda *chiuzi* ni umbo la udogo la *uuzi*, lakini Pakia hafafanui hilo.

reason.en: Cape fig, which shares the name mkuyu
reason.sw: Ficus sur (Cape fig), unaoshiriki jina mkuyu
